units.translation: Athenaeus 11 p. 782e mentions τούς παρ΄ Αἰσχύλω ἀγκυλητοὺς κοττάβους [the ankyletoi kottaboi in Aeschylus], and the scholiast on Aristophanes Peace 1244 mentions them without Aeschylus's name. Athenaeus 15 p. 667c quoted the poet's own verses about the kottabos, which will be discussed under the word κόσσαβος [kottabos].
And having thrown javelins and ankyletoi and a chleson.
